rationale: The composite is directionally consistent with both parent results and not a known published anomaly, but the claim that intangible share and net/gross PP&E measure one latent "verifiability" axis is weak — for intangible-heavy firms ppent/ppegt is computed on a tiny plant base and is mostly noise — so the SUMRANK may simply dilute the stronger intangible-share leg rather than sharpen it.

This is a one-parameter smoothing of the archive's existing best signal, and worse, MA of DELTA(invt,1) telescopes to (invt_t − invt_{t−3})/3, which shrinks the inventory adjustment toward negligible size and effectively reverts the conditioner to plain gross-profitability-on-assets (Novy-Marx), so the test cannot distinguish "persistent cash-conversion failure" from simply dropping the accrual adjustment.

Beyond being a single-input substitution on an already-tested construct, both legs share ppent — low net PP&E simultaneously raises NEG(ppent/ppegt) and the profit-per-capital ratio — so the product largely re-loads on the same variable rather than testing a genuine interaction, and the "cash rents" refinement will not separate that mechanical dependence from the hypothesized hidden-capacity effect.

The diagnosis is correct and specific — the fragility family's flat FMB slopes plausibly stem from non-monotone one-sided legs — and netting cash against current debt into a signed funding gap is a substantive measurement repair rather than a conditioner swap, though the resulting leg overlaps materially with known net-leverage and cash-holdings effects and should be checked against a plain net-debt control.

The floor does what is claimed — the denominator can no longer fall below capx when intangibles amortize, removing sign flips — and the failed generation-7 variant justifies preserving the installed-mix benchmark, but this remains a numerical-stability tweak on an already-working signal and it still degenerates for near-zero-capex firms.

Holding the denominator fixed while restricting the numerator to goodwill is a legitimate and previously unanswered decomposition, but the informational gain is limited because Compustat intan typically subsumes gdwl and the gen-1 signal already used (gdwl+intan)/(ppent+gdwl+intan) with a near-identical conditioner, so the two constructs will be highly correlated and the "which component" verdict may be indeterminate.
